content:
ana-support: Heads up — AcmeOps BulkPush client hitting 429s repeatedly, spikes aligned to minute boundaries. Customer reports ~1.2k req/min bursts and token burn ~3k/min. Started ~03:12 UTC. Can we triage?

charlie-se: forwarding logs from customer (acct 98765). They pushed a deploy yesterday, client runs 12 parallel workers with sync schedule. I asked for raw headers, attaching when I get them.

devon-sre: can you paste one of the 429 responses (headers) + the curl they used? want to confirm Retry-After vs window behavior. Also will pull per-route RPM graph for /v1/bulk_push.

ana-support: pasted from customer:
```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/bulk_push -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d @batch.json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
X-RateLimit-Reqs: 1200/1200
X-RateLimit-Tokens: 3000/3600
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "rate_limited" }
```

mohit-eng: that looks like minute-window exhaustion. X-RateLimit-Reqs is at full cap. Customer's 12 workers are likely aligning on the minute rollover.

devon-sre: confirmed in metrics — /v1/bulk_push shows narrow spikes at 00s of every minute, short but saturating. 1s resolution shows all traffic bunching.

mohit-eng: immediate client mitigation: add jitter to worker start times and implement client-side leaky bucket. sample pseudo: 
```
bucket = TokenBucket(rate=20/sec, capacity=120)
for job in jobs:
  if bucket.take(1): send(job)
  else: sleep(random(50,200)ms)
```
Also recommend batching so they send multiple items per request (our SDK has BulkPush.batch).

ana-support: customer asked if we can just "raise their limit for a few hours" — they need a quick unblocking while they patch.

devon-sre: we can do a temporary RPM bump. I'll open an internal change to increase their per-minute request cap to 3k and tokens to 6k for 72h, mark as emergency. Need product approval for longer.

charlie-se: customer ok with 72h bump. I'll gather contact and confirm rollout window.

devon-sre: done — ticket CREATED-8472, change scheduled in 5m. Also adding a soft-backoff on our side: when minute bucket >90% we will start returning Retry-After with 5s increments to smooth client retries (low risk).

mohit-eng: long term: recommend client migration to SDK batch endpoints + use streaming for very high throughput. Eng will add docs on recommended client-side smoothing and example configs.

ana-support: sending customer note now with immediate actions: 72h quota bump, suggested client patch (jitter + leaky bucket + batching), sample code, and monitoring pointers.

charlie-se: customer replied :thumbsup: and will ship patch in next deploy (ETA 3 hours).

devon-sre: follow-up tasks:
- Confirm bump applied and watch per-minute graphs (devon)
- Provide sample leaky-bucket snippet and SDK batch example (mohit)
- Close support ticket after 24h of stable traffic (ana)

mohit-eng: posting quick SDK snippet I will send to customer in the ticket: 
```js
// use SDK bulkBatch to reduce reqs/min
await Redwood.bulkBatch(items, { batchSize: 50, concurrency: 4, jitterMs: [100,500] })
```

ana-support: thanks team. will keep thread updated. ping me if bump needs rollback.

ratelimit-bot: alert cleared for acct 98765 (after change).

devon-sre: monitoring shows spike amplitude reduced by ~70% after bump + customer patch started. keeping this open until 24h stable.

ana-support: closing loop — customer very pleased. will add to KB: "top-of-minute client alignment causes RPM/TPM 429s — mitigation: jitter, batching, temporary quota bump."
